title: Senior Product Owner - Data & Analytics (m/f/d)
description:
ABOUT YEPODA

Our mission is to bring Clean K-Beauty Innovations, from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US - without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. Our clean, mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea, vegan, cruelty-free, and packed with the best natural and active ingredients.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a fast-growing beauty start-up based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available across Europe and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe - online and in over 250 stores. As a certified B Corp™, we are committed to building a business with purpose. With a team of over 120 brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda’s story every day.

 

We are looking for a Senior Data & Analytics Product Owner to join our growing Data team at Yepoda. In this role, you will partner closely with our Head of Data & Technology to shape how we build and ship data and analytics products across the business - driving alignment with stakeholders, prototyping ideas hands-on, and making sure our data capabilities translate into real commercial outcomes.

 

YOUR TASKS

- Own the company-wide analytics function, i.e., the KPI framework, reporting cadence, BI tooling/glossary, and our decision-support and reporting standards.

- Own the product delivery roadmap for data initiatives for Yepoda's central Data analytics team.

- Translate commercial questions (CAC/LTV, channel mix, contribution margin, cohort behaviour, inventory turnover, etc.) from Marketing, Operations, Finance and other functions into scoped, prioritized data products and repeatable analyses.

- Write product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that data engineering and analytics teams can execute against without ambiguity. Be the person who closes the gap between "the business wants something" and "the team knows what to build."

- Lead discovery and drive experimentation with stakeholders for new data capabilities, from self-serve analytics tooling to ML-powered features.

 

YOUR PROFILE

- 3-5 years in a product management or product owner role in BI or Analytics or closely adjacent role at a relevant D2C, e-commerce, or consumer brand.

- Strong business understanding, you think in terms of impact, not just output. Deep understanding of D2C metrics (e.g., CAC, LTV, CIR/ROAS, contribution margin, cohort analytics, marketing attribution, etc).

- Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. Proven ability to operate at C-level, translating fuzzy commercial questions into sharp, defensible analyses

- Comfortable operating in ambiguity and moving fast in a startup environment. You create structure rather than waiting for it.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

 

NICE TO HAVE

- Exposure to modern data stack concepts (data warehouses, Self-Serve Analytics tools, ML pipelines); you don't need to build them, but knowing the landscape helps.

- Experience writing SQL or working directly with data and AI tools such as Omni and Claude.

 

WHAT WE OFFER

- Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.

- Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.

- Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.

- Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.

- We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.

- Employee Discounts: You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!

- Unique Add On

title: Data Scientist, Data Quality & Provenance Team
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

📊 About our Data Quality & Provenance Team

Our Data Quality & Provenance team sits within Wayve’s AI Platform organisation and builds the evidence that helps teams make confident decisions about the data underpinning our embodied AI systems. We develop statistically robust methods, metrics and tools to determine when data-quality, annotation and evaluation signals can be trusted-and when they cannot.

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Define measurable, statistically rigorous concepts of data quality, including coverage, label quality, uncertainty, provenance and model performance.

- Apply statistical-inference methods to multi-rater annotation, label ambiguity, dataset coverage and black-box model evaluation.

- Partner with annotation, autonomy and evaluation teams to translate practical quality questions into defensible metrics.

- Build automated reports that clearly communicate confidence, limitations and appropriate interpretation.

- Analyse large annotation datasets using Python and SQL to identify quality issues and inform decisions.

- Iterate on metrics and reporting based on feedback from the teams using them.

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Statistical methods for distinguishing genuine data-quality problems from label ambiguity, inconsistent annotation or evaluation noise.

- Labeler and dataset metrics that support training-data selection, simulation, annotation acceptance and model evaluation.

- Reusable quality artefacts that replace one-off analyses with registered, automated metrics and reports.

- Multi-rater and human-in-the-loop ML systems, including approaches such as Dawid-Skene-style models, psychometrics and inter-rater agreement.

- Quality standards spanning coverage, uncertainty, provenance, annotation quality and predictive-model performance.

- Integration of data-science outputs into the platform workflows used by engineering and research teams

🙌 You should apply if

- You have strong foundations in classical statistics, including experimental design, sampling, modelling, estimation and inference.

- You have practical experience with rater or annotator modelling, inter-rater agreement, label uncertainty or related methods.

- You understand data quality across dimensions such as coverage, label quality, uncertainty, provenance and model performance.

- You have worked with annotation tooling, QA methodologies, human-in-the-loop ML systems or multi-rater labelled datasets.

- You have strong Python and SQL skills and are confident analysing large, complex datasets.

- You can turn ambiguous stakeholder questions into rigorous, usable metrics and clearly communicate uncertainty, limitations and decision implications.

- Experience with probabilistic or Bayesian modelling, production platform integrations or safety-critical data would be an advantage.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. title: Product Manager, Chemistry AI Science Factory
description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila's AI Science Factories (AISFs) are the automated experimental systems that let AI learn science by running it. The Chemistry AISF spans a broad array of domains including molecular chemistry and small-molecule synthesis, targeted drug delivery and LNP formulation, colloidal nanochemistry and quantum materials, and the flow-chemistry and analytical backbone that connects them.

We are hiring a Product Manager to own the product layer for the Chemistry AISF; deciding which capabilities we build, in what order, to what specification, and how we know they are working. You will partner with the Chemistry AISF Program Lead, who owns scientific direction, and with AISF Engineering, which owns the build. Your lane is the what and the why : turning commercial pull, scientific ambition, and AI model needs into a prioritized capability roadmap, and then into requirements crisp enough that engineering teams can scope, staff, and execute against them.

What You'll Be Building

• Set the product vision, roadmap, and capability priorities for the Chemistry AISF, spanning molecular chemistry and small-molecule synthesis, targeted drug delivery and formulation, colloidal nanochemistry, and the shared analytical backbone.

• Translate commercial pull, scientific ambition, and AI model needs into a single prioritized roadmap, making the tradeoffs between competing demands explicit and defensible.

• Define what a capability must do to count as delivered, including scope, throughput, performance, and level of autonomy, in requirements that engineering teams can scope, staff, and build against.

• Co-own the Chemistry AISF program charter with the Program Lead, including the capital plan, resourcing, and phasing that turn a roadmap into a funded sequence of work.

• Drive product execution from concept through commissioning across science, engineering, automation, software, and AI.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• MS, PhD, or equivalent experience in chemistry, chemical engineering, materials chemistry, or a closely related field.

• 5+ years in product management, technical product ownership, or a product-adjacent platform role delivering complex hardware and software systems: lab automation, scientific instrumentation, robotics, or ML-enabled experimental platforms.

• Working fluency in at least one Chemistry AISF domain and the ability to get credible quickly in the others. • Hands-on experience with automated synthesis platforms (ChemSpeed or similar), liquid handling under inert atmosphere, or high-throughput formulation systems.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. title: Product Development Owner
description:
Product Development Owner
Buffalo Grove, IL
Monday - Friday 8:00 am - 5:00 pm
Remote
Do you want to build software that removes the manual work tax professionals dread every cycle?
CSC Corptax is looking for a Product Owner who pairs strong product fundamentals with a practical, hands-on approach to AI. You will own outcomes for a product area, work with your scrum team inside an agile delivery model, and find ways to eliminate the repetitive data preparation and validation work our clients do today. You will also use AI in your own daily work to move faster from client problem to shipped capability. Some of your work will extend an established product; some will mean shaping a new concept or rethinking an area from the ground up.
If you measure success by client outcomes, like taking apart a messy process to find what can be automated, and see AI as a tool to change how work gets done (not a buzzword), we want to talk with you.
Some of the things that you will be doing?

•
Own outcomes for your product area: Maintain a Now/Next/Later roadmap tied to system year and PI goals. Define success metrics before work starts, commit to “Now” scope you can deliver, and make clear trade-off decisions when priorities change, including when to cut, pivot, or stop work that evidence says will not deliver the outcome.

•
Shape new concepts and rethink existing areas: Take new products, features, and concepts from idea to adoption, and rebuild existing areas when the current approach no longer serves clients. Make scope decisions with incomplete information, adjust requirements as evidence comes in, and say no without stalling the team.

•
Eliminate manual preparation and validation work: Map how clients prepare, reconcile, and validate data today. Identify the repetitive, error-prone steps and design product capabilities (automation, rules-based checks, AI-assisted workflows) that remove them. Quantify the impact in hours saved, errors prevented, and cycle time reduced.

•
Apply AI responsibly in the product: Partner with engineering to identify where AI adds measurable client value. Define the guardrails a regulated tax environment requires: accuracy, auditability, explainability, data security, and clear points for human review. Before AI work starts, set accuracy thresholds, test datasets, and evaluation criteria with engineering so the team knows what “good enough to ship” means.

•
Use AI to work more efficiently: Use AI to draft and refine Features, user stories, acceptance criteria, test scenarios, and release notes; analyze usage data and client feedback; and explore the codebase to understand current behavior before writing requirements.

•
Run the backlog in an agile framework: Write clear backlog items with testable acceptance criteria in Azure DevOps or Linear. Lead refinement, sprint planning, PI planning, and sprint demos. Identify and manage dependencies across teams.

•
Make insight-driven decisions: Use product analytics, support case trends, and client research to prioritize. Back major roadmap decisions with data, and define and review adoption KPIs within 90 days of each release.

•
Own the client experience end to end: Partner with the escalation owner assigned to your scrum team to understand what clients are reporting about your product, prioritize client issues, and write actionable work items for bugs and enhancements. Validate fixes through user acceptance testing, and apply Corptax UX standards so experiences stay consistent across products.

•
Drive awareness and adoption with go-to-market: Work closely with the go-to-market, Product Marketing, and Marketing teams from concept through launch. Use their view of pipeline strength, demo feedback from sales engineers, and account manager feedback on the product and adoption to shape priorities. Build awareness for new products, features, and concepts, and bring client and market feedback back into the backlog so every release is positioned, adopted, and measured.

title: Project Manager (Software Development)
description:
About the Role
RPMGlobal (RPM) is seeking a Project Manager to join our software development team and help drive the planning, coordination, and delivery of complex software and technology initiatives.
You will work closely with our Software Development Managers, Product Managers and other cross-functional teams to translate priorities into executable plans, manage dependencies and risks, and provide clear visibility into delivery progress.
This role is ideal for an experienced technical project manager who understands software development and can operate effectively across multiple engineering teams, and is comfortable working in a fast-moving environment that combines cloud, edge, AI, geospatial, and industrial technologies.
This is a full-time role, and while it is remote, candidates must be based in Guadalajara.
To be considered for this role, please submit your application in English.
Key Responsibilities

• Lead planning and execution for complex engineering projects, end-to-end.

• Facilitate agile planning and execution practices, adapting the process to the needs of each team and project.

• Coordinate delivery across multiple disciplines, including full-stack, Computer Vision, machine learning, mobile, DevOps, and QA.

• Track project health, KPIs, delivery commitments, and key risks, providing clear status reports to stakeholders.

• Identify process gaps, improve workflows.

• Help standardise planning, tracking, release, and reporting practices.

• Support continuous improvement across project management.

About You

• 8+ years professional experience in project management, technical program management, or engineering delivery roles.

• Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, Agile methodologies, and modern engineering delivery practices.

• Experience with development planning and tracking platforms such as Azure DevOps, Jira or similar.

• Experience defining and tracking development KPIs, delivery metrics, release plans, and resource allocation.

• Experience managing projects with multiple stakeholders and involving multiple teams.

• Strong planning, organisation, facilitation, and problem-solving skills, with a high level of ownership and accountability.

• Fluency in Spanish and English.

• Legally entitled to work in Mexico.

Highly Regarded Qualifications and Experience

• PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, or equivalent certifications.

• Experience coordinating customer-facing or enterprise integration projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.

• Experience in mining, construction, autonomous systems, or other industrial technology environments.

About RPM
RPMGlobal is the mining industry’s leading enterprise technology and training provider and has been at the forefront of change and innovation in the mining industry for over 50 years.​​
We advance the mining industry towards a safer, more efficient, and more sustainable future through the delivery of innovative software solutions and deep domain mining expertise. Guided by our underlying principles of mining expertise, innovation, and sustainability, we strive to create safer and more efficient operations for our mining customers.
Our focus on providing advanced mining enterprise technology and training across the mining lifecycle enables us to guide customers through the industry's current and emerging challenges worldwide. This includes helping them meet the shift in social norms and consumer and investor ESG-related expectations.
Please, no agencies or recruiters.

ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ElevenMusic is our AI music creation platform, letting anyone turn an idea into a finished, studio-grade track in minutes, with control over genre, mood, structure, and vocals across multiple languages. It is one of the most exciting parts of the ElevenCreative suite, and we want its voice, community, and content presence to match the ambition of the product.

We are looking for a Content Creator & Strategist to own how ElevenMusic shows up in the world. You will make music with the platform every day, push it to its limits, and turn what you discover into educational content, tutorials, and social posts that teach creators what's possible. You will own the ElevenMusic social accounts, build and energise the community around the product, and represent ElevenMusic on stage at creator events.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of music creation, content, and community. The right person is a genuine music maker who lives on social platforms, has strong opinions about how an AI music brand should show up, and is just as comfortable behind a mic or on stage as they are in an editing timeline. Because you'll be using the product harder than almost anyone, you'll also be a critical feedback loop into the engineering team, shaping the product itself.

title: Senior Director, Software Engineering - Contract Intelligence
description:
As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloft’s certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.

Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.

We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX = CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

Position Overview
AI is changing CLM, and Agiloft is building what comes next. As Senior Director, Software Engineering - Contract Intelligence, you will lead the engineering teams behind Astra Agents and the Contract Intelligence Graph (CIG). These are the capabilities that turn contracts into intelligence customers act on every day. You will own engineering strategy, organization, and execution across this portfolio, together with the shared platform components and interfaces that serve these experiences.
This is a rare chance to shape and build a converged platform that makes these products work as one and that future Agiloft experiences will build on. The shared platform scope includes common data models and database services, identity and access management (IAM), agent and AI Assistant capabilities, and a unified interface suite spanning APIs, user interfaces, and MCP servers. You will decide how each product consumes these capabilities while preserving the flexibility each experience needs.
Reporting directly to the CTO and working closely with Product, Design, Applied AI & Knowledge Engineering, Core CLM Engineering, and Cloud Operations, you will turn ambitious product priorities into an integrated technical roadmap and dependable delivery that drives measurable customer value.
You will lead managers, technical leaders, and distributed teams. This role is for a leader who stays close to the code, holds a high bar, and builds a culture where strong engineers do their best work.
Success means shared capabilities are adopted across Astra and CLM, the architecture remains secure and scalable, releases are predictable, and the organization can deliver customer value without sacrificing quality, reliability, or long-term maintainability. If you want to shape how enterprises manage their contracts in the AI era, and build the team that makes it happen, we’d love to talk with you.

Ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace is our priority. We are committed to an environment of acceptance where you are free to bring your full self to work. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

SECURITY ARCHITECT, APPLIED FIELD ENGINEERING (AFE)

OVERVIEW

Enterprises are modernizing data platforms at an exponential rate to meet demands for innovation, specifically with the rise of Generative and Agentic AI. As the leading AI and BI platform, Snowflake requires a secure-by-design foundation to drive business value. The Security Applied Field Engineering (AFE) organization is at the forefront of this effort, ensuring that security is a strategic accelerator rather than a bottleneck.

As a Senior Security Architect on the Applied Field Engineering team, you will drive strategic customer engagements and build the prescriptive frameworks required for the modern era. You will transition customers from legacy, siloed security tools to a unified Security Data Architecture. You will partner closely with Sales, GTM, Engineering, and Marketing to help customers transform their business within the Snowflake AI Data Cloud while maintaining a world-class security posture.

 
 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

FIELD ENGINEERING & SECURITY ARCHITECTURE

- Security Architecture Foundation: Drive strategic engagements focused on the Security Architecture, ensuring robust foundations across Identity, Data, and Infrastructure for applications built on Snowflake.

- AI Security & Trust Foundations: Support customer strategy for secure AI adoption, leveraging Snowflake Cortex to bring state-of-the-art LLMs directly to customer data within a secure environment.

- Architect trusted Agentic AI frameworks where Cortex Agents operate within governed boundaries, autonomously orchestrating tasks while inheriting Snowflake's native security perimeter.

- Deploy Cortex Guard and AI Observability to filter harmful content and provide transparent, explainable AI interactions through rigorous monitoring and tracing.

- Ensure AI governance by enforcing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and data masking across all AI-driven insights and automated actions.

- Modern Security Operations (SecOps): Deliver workshops and hands-on engagements to transition customers from legacy infrastructure to advanced SIEM Augmentation, Log Ingestion (Otel/Logs into Snowflake), and Cybersecurity Data Lake.

- Governance & Identity: Build repeatable reference architectures and frameworks for Identity (IAM), Data Governance, Row-Level Security, and Encryption to accelerate well-architected deployments.

- Resilience & Compliance: Guide customers through end-to-end journeys for BC/DR (Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery), including multi-region deployment patterns and measurable recovery outcomes.

- Tooling and Content: Drive the creation of relevant technical content and tooling to showcase security best practices, accelerate new use case deployments, and adoption of new platform functionality.

- Voice of the Field: Influence product roadmaps by serving as the Voice of the Field to Snowflake's product and engineering teams, translating customer needs into actionable feedback.

CORE EXPERIENCE

- 5+ years of industry experience in Data, Security, Networking, Infrastructure or AI Engineering

- Communication Skills: Strong technical communications skills with the ability to deliver compelling demos, whiteboard sessions, and presentations to both technical and business stakeholders.
